radiusSource: Radius 6.119 (6.013 to 6.228) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 4,257,210 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 6.246 (6.147 to 6.362) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 16195 +/- 220.4 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4291462091610511744: teff_gspphot 16194.543 K (16th-84th percentiles 15999.62-16440.488), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
